This allows our thoughts ③ <u>run</u> free without interruption or judgment. Creative people have entire worlds inside their heads, and being alone gives them the opportunity to bring ideas from this inner world into the real world. Steve Wozniak, for example, invented the Apple computer ④ <u>sitting</u> alone at a desk. He says his creativity came from being introverted as a child. ⑤ <u>Had</u> it not been for his shyness, he might not have become a computer expert. However, this does not mean we should stop working together with others. Had it not been for Wozniak's collaboration with Steve Jobs, he could not have started his own business. Therefore, we should seek out solitude, but only when we need it.

Young children write with all their attention focused on each letter. ( ① ) Despite this, it's common for them to write some of the letters backwards. ( ② ) This is called "mirror writing," and it may be caused by the way our brains store images, known as "mirror generalization." ( ③ ) When we remember images, we focus on shape rather than orientation. ( ④ ) Therefore, whether we're looking at a tiger directly or from the side, we still immediately know it's a tiger. ( ⑤ ) It is believed that mirror generalization, combined with a child's weak understanding of right and left, is what causes the occasional backward letter.

Despite the popularity of e-books, most kids still prefer printed books. Unfortunately, making printed books means cutting down trees. But an Argentine children's book called My Father Was in the Jungle can actually be turned back into a tree. Made from acid-free paper and with non-toxic ink, the entire book is environment-friendly. Seeds are also sewn into the book's pages, so it can be transformed into a tree. Once they finish reading the book, children are encouraged to water its cover and put it in a sunny spot. Placing the book in the dirt when the seeds begin to sprout, children can nurture it like any other plant. Although this is just a one-time project, the publisher hopes it will make people aware of the resources needed to produce everyday items such as books.

( ③ ) There are, however, ways to deal with this, such as transplanting only trees that are native to the region. ( ④ ) Both before and after the transplant, be sure to provide the tree with plenty of water. ( ⑤ ) Once successfully transplanted, the tree will require regular watering until it has become firmly established in its new location.

People often omit the period at the end of sentences in single-sentence text messages, which has influenced the way we perceive periods. In an experiment, participants reading text messages found single sentences with a period less sincere than those without one. This could be due to something called "situational code-switching," which simply means that we change how we talk depending on the social setting. For example, the language that students use in the classroom is different from the language they use on the playground. If they talked to their friends the same way they talked to their teachers, it would probably sound strange. ③ changing the topic in the middle of a conversation
